title: Game changer
body: This app is a game changer. I was recently diagnosed with ADHD and have struggled with building and maintaining habits my whole life - InFlow is an easy to use and intuitive app that helps me do just that, with the support of a wonderful community as a bonus! Even if you haven’t yet been officially diagnosed, I can wholeheartedly recommend the app - it will help set you in the right direction with science-backed tips and programmes to follow. I can see that the app could potentially also help family members better understand ADHD as a whole and support their loved ones with ADHD. The student discount is a definite perk! Good luck on your ADHD journey! 🧠✨
author: katjakau
